migrations._comment: Shell command to apply pending DB migrations. Examples: 'bash run_migrations.sh' | 'npx prisma migrate deploy' | 'npm run db:migrate'. Null = skip migration step.

predeploy._comment: Fast, deterministic guards /pre-deploy runs (Step 3.6) before the delta review + E2E suite. Each entry is a shell command; a non-zero exit blocks the deploy. Examples: 'bash lib/deploy/db_compat_lint.sh' (DB-version syntax lint) | 'php bin/role_gate_check.php' (structural/security guard). Empty = skip.

_generated_dirs_comment: Paths (relative to repo root) to silently 'git checkout --' on session start. For auto-regenerated files like Playwright screenshots or coverage reports. Example: ['admin/assets/walkthrough/', 'coverage/badge.svg']

worktrees._comment: Where new git worktrees are created. {name} is substituted with the branch-derived name. Default puts them inside the repo under .worktrees/ (add to .gitignore). Use a sibling path like '../{repo}-{name}' if your repo root must stay on the main branch (e.g. a live web root).

tickets._comment: Optional issue-tracker integration. key_pattern is a regex matching branch names (e.g. 'ACME-[0-9]+'). url_template uses {key} substitution (e.g. 'https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/{key}'). launch_gate_label is the label your team puts on launch-blocking tickets (e.g. 'launch-gating'); /pre-deploy Step 3.5 queries it directly so an unstarted blocker halts the gate. Null = that feature off.

whats_new._comment: format: 'markdown' (append to target_path), 'json' (write JSON array to target_path), or 'custom' (pipe generated content to target_cmd, useful for INSERT-into-DB flows).

serve._comment: Command to serve the current worktree locally for browser testing (e.g. 'npm run dev', or a script that points your local server at this checkout). Null = the serve-worktree skill skips serving and just reports.

slack._comment: Optional Slack DM on PR open/update/merge. notify_user_id is your Slack member id (e.g. 'U01ABC2DEF' — find it via your Slack profile > 'Copy member ID'). Requires the claude.ai Slack connector to be authenticated in your Claude so the slack_send_message tool is available; /create-pr sends the DM best-effort and never blocks on failure. Null = Slack notifications off.

_critical_paths_comment: Path prefixes that warrant extra review scrutiny (auth, payments, migrations). Used by review-pr/create-pr. Empty = no special-casing.
